info.name: Eyada API - Medical Clinic Management
info.description:
Complete API collection for Eyada - Medical Clinic Management System.

This collection includes all endpoints for:
- Authentication (register, login, logout)
- Doctor management
- Patient management
- Clinic management
- Appointment booking
- Schedules and services
- Ratings
- Admin operations

**Base URL:** {{base_url}}
**Authentication:** JWT Bearer Token

exec: // Auto-attach Authorization header if token exists

request.description: Root endpoint - returns welcome message
Health check endpoint - returns status and timestamp

item.name: Auth
item.description: Authentication endpoints for user registration, login, and token management

request.description:
Register a new user (patient, doctor, or secretary).

**Required fields:**
- email: Valid email format
- phoneNumber: Egyptian mobile (01[0125]XXXXXXXX)
- password: 8-50 characters
- fullName: 2-100 characters

**Optional:**
- role: PATIENT (default) or DOCTOR

Login with email and password.

**Rate limited:** 10 attempts per hour

**Required fields:**
- email: Valid email
- password: Min 8 characters
Refresh access token using refresh token.

Logout and invalidate refresh token.

**Requires:** JWT Bearer Token

Logout from all devices.

**Requires:** JWT Bearer Token

Change user password.

**Requires:** JWT Bearer Token

**Fields:**
- currentPassword: Current password
- newPassword: 8-50 characters

Get current authenticated user profile.

**Requires:** JWT Bearer Token

Search doctors with filters and pagination.

**Public endpoint** - No authentication required

Get doctor public profile by ID.

**Public endpoint** - No authentication required

Get current doctor profile.

**Requires:** JWT Bearer Token (DOCTOR role)

Create doctor profile (registration completion).

**Requires:** JWT Bearer Token (DOCTOR role)

**Required:**
- specialtyId: UUID of specialty

**Optional:**
- licenseNumber, yearsOfExperience (0-70)
- qualifications, bio (multilingual ar/en)
- profileImage, showPhoneNumber, showWhatsappNumber
- whatsappNumbers (array)

Update doctor profile.

**Requires:** JWT Bearer Token (DOCTOR role)

Get all ratings for current doctor with statistics.

**Requires:** JWT Bearer Token (DOCTOR role)

item.name: Patients
item.description: Patient profile and family member management

request.description:
Get current patient profile with user data and family members.

**Requires:** JWT Bearer Token (PATIENT role)

Create patient profile.

**Requires:** JWT Bearer Token (PATIENT role)

**All fields optional:**
- dateOfBirth: ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD)
- gender: MALE or FEMALE
- whatsappNumber: Egyptian mobile
- usePhoneAsWhatsapp: boolean
- bloodType: string

Update patient profile.

**Requires:** JWT Bearer Token (PATIENT role)

Get patient medical data (decrypted).

**Requires:** JWT Bearer Token (PATIENT role)

Update patient medical data (encrypted storage).

**Requires:** JWT Bearer Token (PATIENT role)

**Fields:**
- chronicDiseases: array of strings
- allergies: array of strings

Get all family members.

**Requires:** JWT Bearer Token (PATIENT role)

Add a new family member.

**Requires:** JWT Bearer Token (PATIENT role)

**Required:**
- fullName: 2-100 characters
- relationship: SPOUSE, CHILD, PARENT, SIBLING, OTHER

**Optional:**
- dateOfBirth, gender, bloodType

Get a specific family member by ID.

**Requires:** JWT Bearer Token (PATIENT role)

Update a family member.

**Requires:** JWT Bearer Token (PATIENT role)

Remove a family member.

**Requires:** JWT Bearer Token (PATIENT role)

Create a rating for a completed appointment.

**Requires:** JWT Bearer Token (PATIENT role)

**Required:**
- appointmentId: UUID of completed appointment
- rating: 1-5 (integer)

**Optional:**
- review: max 1000 characters

Search clinics with filters and pagination.

**Public endpoint** - No authentication required

**Geo search:** Provide latitude, longitude, and radiusKm for location-based search

Get clinic details by ID.

**Public endpoint** - No authentication required

Get all clinics owned by the current doctor.

**Requires:** JWT Bearer Token (DOCTOR role)

Create a new clinic.

**Requires:** JWT Bearer Token (DOCTOR role)

**Required:**
- name: {ar, en} - 2-200 characters each
- cityId: UUID

**Optional:**
- address, phoneNumber, latitude/longitude
- slotDurationMinutes: 1-60 (default 15)
- isActive: boolean

Get clinic details by ID.

**Requires:** JWT Bearer Token (DOCTOR role)

Update clinic information.

**Requires:** JWT Bearer Token (DOCTOR role)

Toggle clinic active status.

**Requires:** JWT Bearer Token (DOCTOR role)

Delete a clinic.

**Requires:** JWT Bearer Token (DOCTOR role)

Get clinic weekly schedule.

**Public endpoint** - No authentication required

Get available time slots for a specific date.

**Public endpoint** - No authentication required

**Required query:**
- date: YYYY-MM-DD format

Get all schedules for a clinic.

**Requires:** JWT Bearer Token (DOCTOR role)

Create a new schedule entry.

**Requires:** JWT Bearer Token (DOCTOR role)

**Required:**
- dayOfWeek: SUNDAY-SATURDAY

**Optional:**
- startTime/endTime (HH:mm) OR shifts array
- shifts: [{startTime, endTime, breakTime?}]
- slotDuration: 5-120 minutes
- maxPatients: min 1
- isActive: boolean

Update a schedule entry.

**Requires:** JWT Bearer Token (DOCTOR role)

Delete a schedule entry.

**Requires:** JWT Bearer Token (DOCTOR role)

Get all active services for a clinic.

**Public endpoint** - No authentication required

Get all services for a clinic.

**Requires:** JWT Bearer Token (DOCTOR role)

Create a new service type.

**Requires:** JWT Bearer Token (DOCTOR role)

**Required:**
- serviceType: FIRST_VISIT, RE_VISIT, CONSULTATION_PHONE, CONSULTATION_VIDEO
- price: 0-100000

**Optional:**
- name: {ar, en}
- duration: 1-240 minutes
- reVisitValidityDays
- isActive

Get service details by ID.

**Requires:** JWT Bearer Token (DOCTOR role)

Update service type.

**Requires:** JWT Bearer Token (DOCTOR role)

Toggle service active status.

**Requires:** JWT Bearer Token (DOCTOR role)

Delete a service type.

**Requires:** JWT Bearer Token (DOCTOR role)

**Requires:** JWT Bearer Token (PATIENT role)

**Required:**

**Optional:**

- patientProfileId: UUID (for family members)

**Requires:** JWT Bearer Token (PATIENT role)

**Requires:** JWT Bearer Token (PATIENT role)

**Optional body:**
- reason: Cancellation reason
